	(up-full-reset-search)
	(fe-filter-garrisoned c: 1)
	(up-set-group search-local c: migration-boarding-group)

	(up-remove-objects search-local object-data-group-flag != migration-boarding-group)

	(up-remove-objects search-remote object-data-group-flag != migration-transport-group)

	(set-strategic-number sn-keystates 0)
